summary: Iteration 71 — Bulk-add anniversary-fee endpoint + Admin Members UI fully verified. All 12 new backend tests pass and 11/11 iter69+iter70 regression tests still pass. End-to-end UI flow works: select 3 rows → counter '3 selected' → bulk button '+ Add anniversary fee to 3' → dialog prefilled with '10-Year Anniversary Fee'/'150' → confirm button text updates to 'Add to 3 members' → POST /admin/members/balance/bulk-add-line → toast 'Added to 3 member(s)' → 3 '$75.00 owed' badges render → filter pill '3 with open balance' shows → ON narrows to 3 rows, OFF restores 16. Selection survives filter toggle (verified 2 selected → toggle filter → still 2 selected). Clear button correctly resets selection. All test data was cleaned up (3x DELETE → 200).
verifications_performed: Backend: POST /api/admin/members/balance/bulk-add-line happy path → created_count=3, skipped=0, error=0, response shape {created_count, skipped_count, error_count, created_user_ids, skipped_user_ids, errors, label, amount} validated.
Backend: Idempotency — 2nd identical call returns created_count=0, skipped_count=3, skipped_user_ids matches. Also case-insensitive (LABEL vs label.upper() both skip).
Backend: Mixed user_ids (2 valid + 1 bogus uuid) → created_count=2, error_count=1, errors[0].error contains 'not found'.
Backend: Validation 422 verified for empty user_ids, empty label, amount=0, amount=-1, amount=100001.
Backend: GET /api/members surfaces outstanding_balance_total = sum(unpaid amounts) for each member; verified 42.0 after bulk-add of $42.

Frontend (E2E): admin login → /admin → Members → 3 checkboxes ticked → 'bulk-selection-count' shows '3 selected', 'bulk-add-anniversary-fee' shows '+ Add anniversary fee to 3', 'bulk-clear-selection' present.
Frontend: Dialog prefilled bulk-line-label='10-Year Anniversary Fee', bulk-line-amount='150'; bulk-confirm text 'Add to 3 members'.
Frontend: After editing inputs to {label:'TEST_iter71_e2e', amount:'75'} and clicking bulk-confirm → toast 'Added to 3 member(s)'; 3 owes-badge-{id} all render '$75.00 owed'.
Frontend: filter-outstanding-balance pill appears with text '3 with open balance'. Click ON → 3 rows visible (of original 16). Click OFF → 16 rows restored.
Frontend: Selection persistence — selected 2 rows (counter '2 selected'), toggled filter ON, counter still '2 selected' (Set keyed by user id survives filtering).
Cleanup: 3 DELETE /api/admin/members/{id}/balance/lines/{lid} → all 200. Demo dataset clean.
critical_code_review_comments: balances.py L181 `unique_ids = list({uid for uid in body.user_ids if uid})` — set dedups but loses order; created_user_ids ordering is non-deterministic. Not a bug for the UI (frontend doesn't rely on order), but worth a sorted() if a future caller does.

balances.py L184 projection includes is_lifetime_member and member_status but neither is consulted in the loop. Either gate (skip lifetime members or inactive) or drop those projected fields — currently dead weight on the query.

balances.py L209: per-user $push happens in a loop (N round-trips). For the user_ids cap of 2000 this could be slow under load. Consider a single bulk_write with UpdateOne per uid — same number of writes but pipelined. Acceptable for the documented 'small N' admin use case.

server.py L187-190 outstanding_balance_total is recomputed on every GET /api/members. For a chapter with many members this is O(N×lines) per list call. Currently cheap (lines small), but worth caching/storing if balance_lines arrays grow.
Idempotency case-insensitive match (L194) uses .strip().lower() — correct, matches the docstring at L171-173. Confirmed by test_bulk_add_idempotency_is_case_insensitive.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testid wiring verified, E2E + filter + persistence + cleanup)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The /api/members endpoint returns only ~16 members (some demo seeds may be absent — e.g., sam.okafor was not present during this run). When picking 'three_member_ids' fixture, prefer demo emails but fall back to any non-admin member. Admin login does NOT redirect to /dashboard — it lands on '/' (root). Use page.get_by_role('button', name='Log in') to click the submit button, not a generic loop. The bulk endpoint Pydantic model uses min_length=1 on user_ids list — empty array returns 422 (not 400). Frontend filter pill is conditionally rendered only when at least one member has total>0; expect count=0 when no balances exist.
rca of the issue: Not a bug fix — clean feature add. No defects found in iteration 71 backend or frontend implementation. Implementation correctly: (a) returns the documented response shape, (b) is idempotent via case-insensitive unpaid-label match, (c) per-row checkboxes use a Set selectedIds that survives filter changes (matches user requirement 1c), (d) one shared label+amount applied to all (req 2a), (e) skips per-user URL prompts during bulk (req 3a), (f) shows the '$X owed' primary-color pill in the name cell exactly when outstanding_balance_total>0.
